reggadium.options.screen.title: Reggadium Optimization Settings
reggadium.options.enable_optimizations.t: Globally enables or disables all Reggadium performance optimizations.
reggadium.extra.show_fps.name: Show FPS
reggadium.extra.show_fps.tooltip: Displays real-time frame rate with dynamic color coding on screen.
reggadium.extra.show_fps_extended.name: Show Extended FPS
reggadium.extra.show_fps_extended.toolti: Displays minimum, average, and maximum FPS alongside current framerate.
reggadium.extra.show_coords.name: Show Coordinates
reggadium.extra.show_coords.tooltip: Displays player XYZ world coordinates on screen.
reggadium.extra.show_facing.name: Show Direction
reggadium.extra.show_facing.tooltip: Displays player looking direction and axis orientation.
reggadium.extra.show_biome.name: Show Biome
reggadium.extra.show_biome.tooltip: Displays current biome name on screen.
reggadium.extra.show_memory.name: Show Memory (RAM)
reggadium.extra.show_memory.tooltip: Displays current Java heap memory usage and allocation percentage on screen.
reggadium.extra.show_cpu.name: Show CPU Usage
reggadium.extra.show_cpu.tooltip: Displays real-time CPU utilization percentage for the game process on screen.
reggadium.extra.show_gpu.name: Show GPU Usage
reggadium.extra.show_gpu.tooltip: Displays real-time graphics card GPU utilization percentage on screen.
reggadium.extra.show_gametime.name: Show In-Game Time
reggadium.extra.show_gametime.tooltip: Displays Minecraft world clock and day counter on screen.
reggadium.extra.show_ping.name: Show Ping / Latency
reggadium.extra.show_ping.tooltip: Displays network connection latency in milliseconds on screen.
reggadium.extra.overlay_corner.name: HUD Position
reggadium.extra.overlay_corner.tooltip: Choose screen corner to anchor the extra HUD overlay.
reggadium.extra.hud_scale.name: HUD Scale
reggadium.extra.hud_scale.tooltip: Increase or decrease the display size of the extra HUD overlay (50% to 200%).
reggadium.extra.text_contrast.name: Text Contrast
reggadium.extra.text_contrast.tooltip: Choose text rendering style (None, Shadow, or Dark Background).
reggadium.extra.background_opacity.name: Background Opacity
reggadium.extra.background_opacity.toolt: Adjusts background box opacity when text contrast is set to Background.
reggadium.extra.coord_precision.name: Coordinate Precision
reggadium.extra.coord_precision.tooltip: Adjusts decimal precision for XYZ coordinates.
reggadium.extra.color.fps.name: FPS Color
reggadium.extra.color.fps.tooltip: Choose color theme for the FPS counter overlay.
reggadium.extra.color.coords.name: Coordinates Color
reggadium.extra.color.coords.tooltip: Choose color theme for coordinates overlay.
reggadium.extra.color.facing.name: Facing Color
reggadium.extra.color.facing.tooltip: Choose color theme for player facing direction overlay.
reggadium.extra.color.biome.name: Biome Color
reggadium.extra.color.biome.tooltip: Choose color theme for biome overlay.
reggadium.extra.color.memory.name: Memory Color
reggadium.extra.color.memory.tooltip: Choose color theme for RAM / memory overlay.
reggadium.extra.color.cpu.name: CPU Color
reggadium.extra.color.cpu.tooltip: Choose color theme for the CPU usage overlay.
reggadium.extra.color.gpu.name: GPU Color
reggadium.extra.color.gpu.tooltip: Choose color theme for the GPU usage overlay.
reggadium.extra.color.time.name: Time Color
reggadium.extra.color.time.tooltip: Choose color theme for in-game time overlay.
reggadium.extra.color.ping.name: Ping Color
reggadium.extra.color.ping.tooltip: Choose color theme for ping / latency overlay.
reggadium.options.fast_sbb.name: Direct SuperByteBuffer Streaming
reggadium.options.fast_sbb.tooltip: Bypasses heap vertex allocation by streaming Create contraption and kinetic models directly to native GPU memory buffers.
reggadium.options.backface_culling.name: Kinetic Backface Culling
reggadium.options.backface_culling.toolt: Discards inward and backward facing triangles on rotating Create machinery, saving GPU fill rate and reducing micro-stutters.
reggadium.options.fast_light_cache.name: Kinetic Light Caching
reggadium.options.fast_light_cache.toolt: Caches lighting lookups for rotating components (with an automatic 8192-entry memory guard) to eliminate repeated level queries.
reggadium.options.cull_belts.name: Belt & Item Culling
reggadium.options.cull_belts.tooltip: Frustum culls Create mechanical belts and transported items when off-screen or distant, drastically increasing FPS in automated factories.
reggadium.options.kinetic_culling.name: Kinetic Frustum Culling
reggadium.options.kinetic_culling.toolti: Completely halts rendering passes for kinetic blocks outside the player's view frustum or beyond render distance.
reggadium.options.skip_stationary_kineti: Skips redundant angle calculations, matrix transformations, and rotation math for stopped or unpowered machines.
reggadium.options.kinetic_audio_throttli: Throttles soundscape calculations and culls sound queries for distant running machinery to eliminate client tick lag.
reggadium.options.kinetic_lod.name: Kinetic Rotation LOD
reggadium.options.kinetic_lod.tooltip: Applies smooth rotational level-of-detail to distant spinning shafts and cogwheels to reduce vertex transformation jitter.
reggadium.options.reduce_block_entity_la: Reduces client-side update frequency and processing load for kinetic block entities situated outside the visible field of view.
reggadium.options.cull_block_entities.to: Frustum culls vanilla and modded block entities (chests, furnaces, signs, banners) when outside the camera view.
reggadium.options.cull_particles.name: Particle Frustum Culling
reggadium.options.cull_particles.tooltip: Skips quad vertex generation and rasterization for particles positioned outside the player's camera frustum.
Applies distance-based level-of-detail to moving contraptions, skipping detailed actor animation passes when far away.
reggadium.options.optimize_entity_render: Formats entity and block entity vertices directly into native GPU memory structures to eliminate memory allocation spikes.
